dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped light-bordered rings along the flank. Perimeters show a diffuse gradient transitioning from dark background to light grey/white. Notable structures include a circular ring posterior to the pectoral flipper and an interlocking series of annuli along the posterior dorsal-lateral ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid light-grey clusters concentrated between macro-annuli and along the dorsal midline. These lack internal gradients and appear as irregular, high-intensity pixel groups.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent mid-flank rings form an obtuse triangle, with the central centroid serving as the vertex for an interior angle of approximately 150-160 degrees.

other_distinctive_markers: The macro-annuli along the posterior-lateral section exhibit partial overlap, creating a continuous, chain-like high-contrast pattern.
